steps.warmUp: Start with the warm-up, as in every singing lesson: a few easy minutes to wake up your voice.
steps.faSol: Two more steps: fa and sol. Do, re, mi, fa, sol are the first five notes of the scale. Keep each step small and even: the same easy distance from one note to the next.
steps.fiveSteps: Up to sol and back down to do, waiting at each note.
steps.upToSol: Listen, then sing it in time: up to sol, hold it, and back down.
steps.alongToSol: The same, singing along with the guide melody.
